component.name: Corewatch
component.summary: Watch your processor, memory, disks and more

description.p: Corewatch is a native system monitor for Linux. It shows what your computer is doing right now, with a live graph for every resource.

ul.li: Processor: total usage, one graph per core, model and frequency
Memory: used, available, cache, buffers and swap
Graphics: usage or clock, video memory and temperature
Disks: activity, read and write speed, and free space
Battery: charge, time remaining, power draw and health

description.p: It follows the system light and dark style and accent color, and adapts to narrow windows.

ul.li: New Graphics, Disks and Battery pages
Preferences: color scheme and update speed
A banner tells you when a data source stops answering
Installable with Meson, and available as a Flatpak

description.p: Log file and clearer error reports.
